execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "accessToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "accountId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idToken" text,
  "issuer" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment" (
  "content" character varying(1024) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ticketId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment_attachment" (
  "commentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "contentType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invitation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "inviterId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "invitation_role_check_7f9f6ca4" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_role_check_7f9f6ca4" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member_permission" (
  "canCreate" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "canDelete" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "canUpdate" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "memberId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "resourceType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_permission_resourceType_check_1a9bee1a" CHECK ("resourceType" IN ('TICKET', 'COMMENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "logo" text,
  "metadata" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "activeOrganizationId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ticket" (
  "bounty" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deadline" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text DEFAULT 'No description provided' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ticket_status_check_21bcd8dd" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ticket_attachment" (
  "contentType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "ticketId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ticket_reference" (
  "fromId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "toId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("fromId", "toId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
